appDescription: A pickup app for drivers that shares the exact pickup point, live locations and arrival time with the passenger being picked up.

function.name: GET_PICKUP_STATUS
function.description: Tell the driver the status of the current pickup: the passenger's name, the pickup place, the time left until arrival, and whether the passenger has checked the pickup location, is sharing location or has boarded.

function.name: CALL_PASSENGER
function.description: Open the phone dialer to call the passenger of the current pickup.

function.name: COMPLETE_BOARDING
function.description: Confirm that the passenger of the current pickup has boarded, and end the pickup guidance and the location sharing.
